meta.purpose: Locally registered companies able to bid in national-only tenders (India GeM Class-1/2, Bangladesh e-GP, PhilGEPS, VN muasamcong, TH e-GP, BR pregão) that could buy from ISP Group LLC (US trader, CN/IN factories) as their supplier
meta.method: Parallel search/fetch (rate-limited -> WebSearch/curl), public award records: Metro Roxas WD NOA/NTP PDFs; ZCWD BAC NTP archive (234 PDFs 2025-26 OCR'd with tesseract); BetterGov PhilGEPS awardee pages; Bangladesh e-GP ViewAwardedContracts + BPPA NOA; tender247 GeM AOC listings; PNCP API (item lists; results endpoint rate-limited 429), SAAE atas/homologações, TCE-CE licitações portal, municipal diários; Receita CNPJ mirrors; company sites, stock-exchange pages.
meta.verification_rule: verified=true only if email AND phone each found in >=2 independent sources (company's own multiple sites count as one). verified_email/verified_phone flag partials. No contacts invented; null where not found.
meta.sanctions: Names screened against OFAC SDN.CSV downloaded 15.11.2026 (sanctionslistservice.ofac.treas.gov): no matches (only false-positive substring 'HACO'). VITRICHEM/SOCHEM are VINACHEM (state) subsidiaries - formal KYC still needed. EU/UN/UK lists not screened.
meta.gaps: Vietnam muasamcong/dauthau.asia and Thai gprocurement/PWA award data blocked (403/JS) -> no confirmed award records for VN/TH partners; Bangladesh DWASA/KWASA PAC awards need pkgLotId (not discoverable); GeM bid result pages behind login; PNCP results API rate-limited so São Mateus/Bocaiúva previous-year winners not retrieved. ONGC PAC/ferric chloride and resin (MRPL/SAIL/NFL/BARC) GeM winners not identified.
